articles.title: Cedar Ridge Welcomes a New Season of Student Voices
articles.deck: The Regulator is open for submissions from every grade
articles.author: The Editorial Staff
articles.body:
Welcome to the first edition of the Cedar Ridge Regulator, the school’s home for news, sports, opinion, and the arts.

This is a sample article. Open the Editor’s Desk at /admin, log in, and you can edit or delete this story and publish your own.

Stories are written in plain text. Leave a blank line between paragraphs and they will be set in proper newspaper columns.
